x-card.description: Collections and records of Chroma and Chroma Cloud: metadata-filtered pages and nearest-neighbour search by embedding or record. Upserts and deletes wait for approval.

url.title: Server URL
url.description: Chroma's address with https:// (Chroma Cloud: https://api.trychroma.com) and its port for a server of your own (8000 by default). Plain http:// only to this computer.

tenant.title: Tenant
tenant.description: The tenant of the collections: default_tenant on a server of your own, your tenant's id on Chroma Cloud.

database.title: Database
database.description: The database of the collections: default_database on a server of your own, the database's name on Chroma Cloud.

collections.title: Collections
collections.description: The collections agents may use; * matches any characters, such as docs_*. Empty: every collection the credentials see.

method.title: Authentication
method.description: Chroma Cloud signs in with an API key in X-Chroma-Token. A server of your own checks a token only when its auth is set up; No authentication only for a server that checks none, never on prod.

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: A private CA. Policies set row limits and timeouts per environment.

caCertificate.title: CA certificate (PEM)
caCertificate.description: Only for a server whose certificate comes from a private CA.
